threads.body: `configuration_refs` still points at `common.controller-telemetry.enabled`, but the telemetry block is now unconditional (`when: default`). If controller telemetry is meant to gate these metrics/spans, this change will enable them even when the flag is off. Consider restoring the original `when: otel.instrumentation.common.experimental.controller-telemetry.enabled=true` for this block, or update `configuration_refs` and the gating strategy to reflect the new intended behavior.

threads.body: After this change, the `otel.semconv-stability.opt-in=service.peer` block no longer includes the INTERNAL span, and that span is now only present when controller-telemetry is enabled. If the INTERNAL span is semconv-related (rather than controller-telemetry-related), it likely belongs under the semconv-only `when` block as before. If this behavior change is intended, adding a short inline comment near these `when` blocks explaining the rationale would prevent future confusion.
